subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 80 to
guide_solution: Summary The text deals with the struggle of the working people to meet their demand. During industrial revolution, workers worked in factories upto fourteen or even more hours a day. They were paid meagre wages and there had been no safety law for them. So in 1880s, a struggle was organized by the deprived workers to settle for minimum wages, safety laws and eight-hour work day. In 1886 the workers went on strikers pressing on their demand. Guns were fired at them, killing one and injuring many. But ultimately nobody could suppress them. Today they enjoy what they had sought and fought for and the day is now observed as 'International Workers Day' throughout the world.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Bindubasini Govt. Boys' High School, Tangail. Sl. No. 19; Page No. 66
